column7: structural half of credential-under-suspend-001/002 (#2701): asserts all THREE credential-row inserts (CreatePersonalAccessToken, CreateSession, RotateSession) do their insert inside a transaction AND call requireLiveCredentialOwner, and that requireLiveCredentialOwner goes through lockLiveParent rather than a plain read (an unlocked re-read would not serialize against the sweep's LockUserForUpdate). The population of three is DERIVED and the derivation is written into the test: the sweep paths revoke exactly two tables, so the population is every LocalStorage method inserting into one of them, which a repo grep confirms is exactly those three (CreateSetupToken inserts a different table and is correctly out of scope). The account_state predicate reuses globalAdminLiveAccountStates -- the SAME slice, not a copy -- so TestGlobalAdminLiveAccountStates_MatchAccountLoginBlocked keeps it in step with core.AccountLoginBlocked and there is no second list to drift
